name: N-t-BOC-MDMA
summary: N-t-BOC-MDMA, also known as N-tert-butoxycarbonyl-MDMA, is a chemical compound which can be both a synthetic precursor to, or a prodrug of the entactogenic drug MDMA ("ecstasy"). It was first identified in Australia in 2015 as a seizure by customs, and has subsequently been found in China, the Netherlands and other European countries.

pharmacology.text: N-t-BOC-MDMA, also known as N-tert-butoxycarbonyl-MDMA, is a chemical compound which can be both a synthetic precursor to, or a prodrug of the entactogenic drug MDMA ("ecstasy").

uses.text: Similar N-protected compounds such as N-t-BOC-methamphetamine, N-p-tosyl-methamphetamine, N-t-BOC-ketamine, N-t-BOC-norketamine, and N-methoxycarbonyl-MDA have also been encountered by law enforcement.

summaryZh: N-t-BOC-MDMA（化學名：N-叔丁氧羰基-3,4-亞甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C16H23NO4，可作為苯丙胺類興奮劑MDMA（3,4-亞甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）的前體藥物。
summaryZhHans: N-t-BOC-MDMA（化学名：N-叔丁氧羰基-3,4-亚甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式为C16H23NO4，可作为苯丙胺类兴奋剂MDMA（3,4-亚甲二氧甲基苯丙胺）的前体药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. If it is turned into MDMA, it could cause MDMA's effects, which include jaw clenching, overheating, a fast heart rate and, in serious cases, dangerous overheating, low blood sodium or serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。如果它轉變成 MDMA，就可能產生 MDMA 的作用，包括咬牙、體溫升高、心跳加快，嚴重時可能出現危險的高體溫、低血鈉或血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。如果它转变成 MDMA，就可能产生 MDMA 的作用，包括咬牙、体温升高、心跳加快，严重时可能出现危险的高体温、低血钠或血清素症候群。

fact.en: Boc is a protecting group, a chemical cap that chemists use to mask an amine during synthesis, and it can be taken off with acid to give back the original molecule, here MDMA.
fact.zh: Boc 是一種「保護基」，化學家在合成時用它暫時遮蓋胺基，之後可用酸把它移除，還原出原本的分子，在這裡就是 MDMA。
fact.zhHans: Boc 是一种「保护基」，化学家在合成时用它暂时遮盖胺基，之后可用酸把它移除，还原出原本的分子，在这里就是 MDMA。
